006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import java.time.ZonedDateTime;
009import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.DateWithTimeZoneItemImpl;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
016import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
018
019/**
020 * An atomic Metapath item containing a date data value that has an explicit
021 * timezone.
022 */
023public interface IDateWithTimeZoneItem extends IDateItem {
024  /**
025   * Get the type information for this item.
026   *
027   * @return the type information
028   */
029  @NonNull
030  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IDateWithTimeZoneItem> type() {
031    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.DATE_WITH_TZ.getItemType();
032  }
033
034  @Override
035  default IAtomicOrUnionType<IDateWithTimeZoneItem> getType() {
036    return type();
037  }
038
039  /**
040   * Construct a new date item using the provided string {@code value}.
041   *
042   * @param value
043   *          a string representing a date
044   * @return the new item
045   */
046  @NonNull
047  static IDateWithTimeZoneItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
048    try {
049      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.DATE_WITH_TZ.parse(value));
050    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
051      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
052          null,
053          String.format("Invalid date value '%s'. %s",
054              value,
055              ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
056          ex);
057    }
058  }
059
060  /**
061   * Construct a new date item using the provided {@code value}.
062   *
063   * @param value
064   *          a date, with time zone information
065   * @return the new item
066   */
067  @NonNull
068  static IDateWithTimeZoneItem valueOf(@NonNull ZonedDateTime value) {
069    return new DateWithTimeZoneItemImpl(
070        // ignore time
071        ObjectUtils.notNull(value.truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.DAYS)));
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
076   *
077   * @param item
078   *          the item to cast
079   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
080   *         cast to this type
081   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
082   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
083   */
084  @NonNull
085  static IDateWithTimeZoneItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
086    IDateWithTimeZoneItem retval;
087    if (item instanceof IDateWithTimeZoneItem) {
088      retval = (IDateWithTimeZoneItem) item;
089    } else if (item instanceof ITemporalItem) {
090      retval = fromTemporal((ITemporalItem) item);
091    } else if (item instanceof IStringItem || item instanceof IUntypedAtomicItem) {
092      try {
093        retval = valueOf(item.asString());
094      } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
095        // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
096        throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
097      }
098    } else {
099      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(
100          String.format("unsupported item type '%s'", item.getClass().getName()));
101    }
102    return retval;
103  }
104
105  @NonNull
106  private static IDateWithTimeZoneItem fromTemporal(@NonNull ITemporalItem temporal) {
107    if (!temporal.hasTimezone()) {
108      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
109      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(
110          String.format("Unable to cast the temporal value '%s', since it lacks timezone information.",
111              temporal.asString()));
112    }
113    if (!temporal.hasDate()) {
114      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
115      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(
116          String.format("Unable to cast the temporal value '%s', since it lacks date information.",
117              temporal.asString()));
118    }
119    // get the time at midnight
120    return new DateWithTimeZoneItemImpl(ObjectUtils.notNull(ZonedDateTime.of(
121        temporal.getYear(),
122        temporal.getMonth(),
123        temporal.getDay(),
124        0,
125        0,
126        0,
127        0,
128        temporal.getZoneOffset())));
129  }
130
131  @Override
132  default IDateWithTimeZoneItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
133    return cast(item);
134  }
135}
